cases.name: ast spans: group by and an aggregate

cases.name: references: keys in clause groupBy, aggregate arguments on the rows, select keys and rows excluded
cases.notes: A post-group clause reads the GROUP scope: its steps end with the `groupBy` node (printed as the clause), and `rows` as a receiver adds a step one deeper. A bare key name there is the key (not a reference); `^lo` from the rows block reads the group's key `lo`.
cases.query: select city, n: sum(pay), names: rows collect { select name where age > ^lo } from people where active group by city, lo: age having count() > 1 order by city

steps.expr: group by city: city, lo: age
